description: Agent Insurance: submit one policy’s coverage scope with the insured activity or need: the policy with its number, insurer and named insured, the classes of business or activity it states it covers, the covered perils or scope items as recorded, every insured party (the named insured and any additional insureds), the covered locations or territory, the dates it takes effect and expires and the coverage grant as written; and the activity with its description, the class it falls in, the perils it needs covered, the parties that need cover, where it happens and its first and last days. The signed report gives the policy, the activity, the activity’s class against the classes the policy states, every peril, party and location the activity needs with the policy entry that covers it or none, worldwide or anywhere wording reaching every location, and the activity’s dates against the policy period with the days before it takes effect, the days after it expires and the days to spare, and counts them, and names a coverage gap: an activity class outside the policy’s classes, activity dates outside the policy period, and no peril, no party or no location the activity needs covered as recorded; then some perils, parties or locations left uncovered and a policy that expires within 30 days of the activity’s end, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No activity class or policy classes, no needed perils or covered perils, no parties or insureds, no covered locations for a located activity, no policy period or no activity dates leaves the coverage unverified. This reads one policy’s coverage against the insured activity: a counterparty’s certificate or policy excerpt read as diligence evidence against required coverages is wever_insurance-evidence-check, a warranty claim against warranty terms is wever_warranty-check and a proposed agent action against a written policy is wever_policy-fit-check. Verdict insurance_coverage_gap, insurance_coverage_partial, insurance_coverage_unverified or insurance_coverage_covered. POST /api/insurance-coverage-check. Reads the insurance records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, claim filing, coverage binding or external write. Agent Insurance reads an insurance policy after the fact, from the subject’s own records: the coverage against the insured activity, the exclusions against the activity and its parts, the limits against the stated exposure, the deductible against what the buyer was told, the claims deadlines against an incident, a certificate against the policy it was issued from, incident notice under the policy and a renewal against the expiring policy. Beside it, wever_insurance-evidence-check reads a counterparty’s insurance certificate or policy excerpt as diligence evidence and reports what that material establishes against required coverages, limits and a work window, while an insurance check reads the subject’s own policy against a stated need, an incident or a certificate issued from it; wever_warranty-check reads a warranty claim against warranty terms, while an insurance check reads an insurance policy; and wever_risk-downside-check reads a planned action’s downside before it is taken, while an insurance check reads the policy behind it after the fact. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-insurance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-insurance/.
